newsitem.title: HONG KONG: H.K. gold closes unchanged from New York levels.
newsitem.headline: H.K. gold closes unchanged from New York levels.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended Monday unchanged from New York's Friday close at US$352.00/50 an ounce after holding within a 40-cent range in extremely quiet trade, dealers said.
"There is nothing in the market which can move prices either way," said a dealer at a major bak.

"The market is mixed on the immediate gold trend with support seen at US$350 and resistance at US$355," another dealer added. "I saw no trading interest as most players wanted to take square positions."
Local gold ended HK$2 higher at HK$3,261 a tael.
The carry over charge for at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society remained unchanged from its Saturday fix at -3.00.
